newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore signs $165 mln causeway contract.
newsitem.headline: Singapore signs $165 mln causeway contract.

text.p: Singapore signed a Singapore $238 million (US$165 million) contract on Monday with Korea's Hyundai Engineering and Construction Co and a local firm to build a road linking the city with an offshore island.

Announcing the deal, Koo Tsai Kee. parliamentary secretary for national development, said the road would be a catalyst for the development of Jurong Island, which the government aims to turn into a focus for the chemical and petrochemical industries.
The four-lane road, in the form of a causeway, would include a pontoon section which could be floated away to allow vessels to pass through.

"This road link will thus contribute to the commercial attractiveness of Jurong Port, as well for shipyards and industries in the area. It will be completed and opened to traffic by the end of 1998," Koo said.
Hyundai's Singapore partner is Koon Transportation and Construction Pte Ltd.
